checks.name: Stopping an effect releases its peak budget immediately
Effect playback false leaves no sound or occupied mixer slot
Voice playback false restores the mix and releases the channel
Effect playback throw leaves no sound or occupied mixer slot
Voice playback throw restores the mix and releases the channel
Muting cancels a loading voice and late completion cannot restart it
An externally stopped or destroyed voice always releases ducking
Voice at zero does not duck music; raising it during speech restores ducking
Each duck owner releases only its own request
A paused voice and an unfinished load are both canceled by scene suspension
